instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside a judo dojo with yellow and blue tatami mats and a white paneled wall. The woman in the blue judo gi (R1) stands on the left with her back to the camera, sparring with the young man in the white judo gi (R2) who stands on the right facing her. They grip each other's uniforms in a judo stance. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene.
